install_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eo pipefail

export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
export USER="${USER:-root}"
INSTALL_DIR="/opt/deepseek-harness"
REPO_URL="https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git"
REPO_BRANCH="master"
SERVICE_NAME="deepseek-harness.service"
WRAPPER="/usr/local/bin/deepseek-harness-web"
SERVICE_HELPER="/usr/local/lib/containerws/deepseek-harness-service.sh"
DSH_PORT="${DSH_PORT:-3080}"
DSH_HOST="${DSH_HOST:-127.0.0.1}"
NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"
NVM_VERSION="v0.40.5"

has_systemd() {
  command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -d /run/systemd/system ]
}

echo "==> Installing DeepSeek Harness (dsh)"
echo "    https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness"

apt_update_safe() {
  local opts=(-o APT::Get::List-Cleanup=0)
  if [[ -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources ]]; then
    apt-get update "${opts[@]}" \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list.d/ubuntu.sources \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- && return 0
  fi
  if [[ -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources ]]; then
    apt-get update "${opts[@]}" \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list.d/debian.sources \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- && return 0
  fi
  if [[ -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/kali.sources ]]; then
    apt-get update "${opts[@]}" \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list.d/kali.sources \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- && return 0
  fi
  if [[ -f /etc/apt/sources.list ]]; then
    apt-get update "${opts[@]}" \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list \
      -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- && return 0
  fi
  apt-get update \
    -o Acquire::AllowInsecureRepositories=true \
    -o Acquire::AllowDowngradeToInsecureRepositories=true
}

install_base_deps() {
  if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
    apt_update_safe
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git curl ca-certificates bash
  elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    dnf install -y git curl ca-certificates bash
  elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apk add --no-cache git curl ca-certificates bash
  elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    pacman -Sy --noconfirm git curl ca-certificates bash
  else
    echo "ERROR: unsupported package manager" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

install_base_deps

ensure_node() {
  mkdir -p "$HOME"
  local need_nvm=1
  if [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ]; then
    set +u
    . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
    command -v nvm >/dev/null 2>&1 && need_nvm=0
    set -u
  fi
  if [ "$need_nvm" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "==> Installing NVM ${NVM_VERSION}"
    rm -rf "$NVM_DIR"
    curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/${NVM_VERSION}/install.sh" -o /tmp/nvm-install.sh
    bash /tmp/nvm-install.sh
    rm -f /tmp/nvm-install.sh
  fi
  set +u
  . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
  if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "==> Installing Node.js LTS"
    nvm install --lts
    nvm alias default 'lts/*'
  fi
  nvm use default
  if ! command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "==> Installing pnpm"
    npm install -g pnpm@latest
  fi
  set -u
  echo "    Node: $(node -v)  pnpm: $(pnpm -v)"
}

ensure_node

if [ -d "$INSTALL_DIR/.git" ]; then
  echo "==> Updating existing checkout"
  git -C "$INSTALL_DIR" fetch origin "$REPO_BRANCH"
  git -C "$INSTALL_DIR" reset --hard "origin/${REPO_BRANCH}"
else
  echo "==> Cloning repository"
  rm -rf "$INSTALL_DIR"
  git clone --branch "$REPO_BRANCH" "$REPO_URL" "$INSTALL_DIR"
fi

set +u
. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
nvm use default
set -u

cd "$INSTALL_DIR"
echo "==> Installing dependencies (pnpm install)"
pnpm install
echo "==> Building (pnpm run build)"
pnpm run build

mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/containerws

cat > "$WRAPPER" << 'WRAPPER_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"
set +u
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
nvm use default >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
set -u
cd /opt/deepseek-harness
exec pnpm dsh web --no-open --host "${DSH_HOST:-127.0.0.1}" --port "${DSH_PORT:-3080}"
WRAPPER_EOF
chmod 755 "$WRAPPER"

cat > "$SERVICE_HELPER" << 'HELPER_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# DeepSeek Harness service helper — works with systemd or direct (nohup) mode.
set -euo pipefail

export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
INSTALL_DIR="/opt/deepseek-harness"
WRAPPER="/usr/local/bin/deepseek-harness-web"
SERVICE_NAME="deepseek-harness.service"
DATA_DIR="${HOME}/.deepseek-harness"
PIDFILE="${DATA_DIR}/deepseek-harness.pid"
LOG="${DATA_DIR}/deepseek-harness.log"
DSH_PORT="${DSH_PORT:-3080}"
DSH_HOST="${DSH_HOST:-127.0.0.1}"

has_systemd() {
  command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -d /run/systemd/system ]
}

is_running() {
  if has_systemd; then
    systemctl is-active --quiet "$SERVICE_NAME" 2>/dev/null
    return $?
  fi
  if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$PIDFILE")" 2>/dev/null; then
    return 0
  fi
  return 1
}

cmd_start() {
  mkdir -p "$DATA_DIR"
  if is_running; then
    echo "DeepSeek Harness already running"
    return 0
  fi
  if has_systemd && [ -f "/etc/systemd/system/${SERVICE_NAME}" ]; then
    systemctl daemon-reload || true
    systemctl enable "$SERVICE_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    systemctl start "$SERVICE_NAME"
    echo "Started via systemd: ${SERVICE_NAME}"
    return 0
  fi
  if [ ! -x "$WRAPPER" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: wrapper missing at $WRAPPER — install DeepSeek Harness first" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  nohup env DSH_HOST="$DSH_HOST" DSH_PORT="$DSH_PORT" "$WRAPPER" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 &
  echo $! >"$PIDFILE"
  sleep 2
  if kill -0 "$(cat "$PIDFILE")" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Started in background (pid $(cat "$PIDFILE"))"
    echo "Web UI: http://${DSH_HOST}:${DSH_PORT}"
    echo "Log: $LOG"
  else
    echo "ERROR: process exited — see $LOG" >&2
    tail -n 30 "$LOG" >&2 || true
    exit 1
  fi
}

cmd_stop() {
  if has_systemd && [ -f "/etc/systemd/system/${SERVICE_NAME}" ]; then
    systemctl stop "$SERVICE_NAME" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
    pid="$(cat "$PIDFILE")"
    kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    sleep 1
    kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
  fi
  pkill -f 'pnpm dsh web' 2>/dev/null || true
  echo "DeepSeek Harness stopped"
}

cmd_restart() {
  cmd_stop
  sleep 1
  cmd_start
}

cmd_status() {
  if is_running; then
    echo "DeepSeek Harness: running"
    if has_systemd; then
      systemctl --no-pager --full status "$SERVICE_NAME" 2>/dev/null || true
    elif [ -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
      echo "  pid: $(cat "$PIDFILE")"
      echo "  log: $LOG"
    fi
    curl -s -o /dev/null -w "  HTTP %{http_code} on http://127.0.0.1:${DSH_PORT}/\n" "http://127.0.0.1:${DSH_PORT}/" 2>/dev/null || true
  else
    echo "DeepSeek Harness: stopped"
    return 1
  fi
}

case "${1:-status}" in
  start) cmd_start ;;
  stop) cmd_stop ;;
  restart) cmd_restart ;;
  status) cmd_status ;;
  *) echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|status}" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

HELPER_EOF
chmod 755 "$SERVICE_HELPER"

if has_systemd; then
  cat > "/etc/systemd/system/${SERVICE_NAME}" << UNIT_EOF
[Unit]
Description=DeepSeek Harness Web UI
Documentation=https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
Environment=HOME=/root
Environment=NVM_DIR=/root/.nvm
Environment=DSH_HOST=${DSH_HOST}
Environment=DSH_PORT=${DSH_PORT}
Environment=PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
ExecStart=${WRAPPER}
WorkingDirectory=${INSTALL_DIR}
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT_EOF
  systemctl daemon-reload || true
else
  echo "==> Direct mode (no systemd) — service runs via nohup background"
fi

"$SERVICE_HELPER" restart || "$SERVICE_HELPER" start

COMMIT="$(git -C "$INSTALL_DIR" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
echo "==> DeepSeek Harness installed (commit ${COMMIT})"
echo "    Web UI: http://${DSH_HOST}:${DSH_PORT}"
echo "    Control: ${SERVICE_HELPER} {start|stop|restart|status}"
"$SERVICE_HELPER" status || true
uninstall_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

INSTALL_DIR="/opt/deepseek-harness"
SERVICE_NAME="deepseek-harness.service"
WRAPPER="/usr/local/bin/deepseek-harness-web"
SERVICE_HELPER="/usr/local/lib/containerws/deepseek-harness-service.sh"
DATA_DIR="${HOME:-/root}/.deepseek-harness"

has_systemd() {
  command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -d /run/systemd/system ]
}

echo "==> Removing DeepSeek Harness"

if [ -x "$SERVICE_HELPER" ]; then
  "$SERVICE_HELPER" stop 2>/dev/null || true
fi

if has_systemd; then
  systemctl disable "$SERVICE_NAME" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
rm -f "/etc/systemd/system/${SERVICE_NAME}"
if has_systemd; then
  systemctl daemon-reload 2>/dev/null || true
fi

rm -f "$WRAPPER" "$SERVICE_HELPER"
rm -rf "$INSTALL_DIR" "$DATA_DIR"

echo "==> DeepSeek Harness removed (NVM/Node left intact)"
upgrade_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eo pipefail

export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
INSTALL_DIR="/opt/deepseek-harness"
REPO_BRANCH="master"
NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"
SERVICE_HELPER="/usr/local/lib/containerws/deepseek-harness-service.sh"

echo "==> Upgrading DeepSeek Harness (pull latest, rebuild, restart)"

if [ ! -d "$INSTALL_DIR/.git" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: ${INSTALL_DIR} not found — install the package first" >&2
  exit 1
fi

"$SERVICE_HELPER" stop 2>/dev/null || true

set +u
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
nvm use default >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
set -u

cd "$INSTALL_DIR"
echo "==> Pulling latest commit from origin/${REPO_BRANCH}"
git fetch origin "$REPO_BRANCH"
git reset --hard "origin/${REPO_BRANCH}"
COMMIT="$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
echo "    at commit: ${COMMIT}"

echo "==> Installing dependencies"
pnpm install

echo "==> Building"
pnpm run build

"$SERVICE_HELPER" start

echo "==> Upgrade complete — service running in background"
"$SERVICE_HELPER" status || true
